quote: In a celebrated paper of 1893, Hadamard established the maximal determinant theorem
note: The conjecture about existence of Hadamard matrices of order 4k originated in Hadamard's 1893 paper 'Résolution d'une question relative aux déterminants' (Resolution of a question relative to determinants), published in Bulletin des Sciences Mathématiques, Volume 2, pages 240-246.
